question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

No longer used because something new has been invented
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4. i.e. **"Obsolete".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Obsolete**: No longer produced or used; out of date. (अप्रचलित: अब उत्पादित या इस्तेमाल नहीं किया जाता; तारीख से बाहर।)
 
• **Obsolete **correctly expresses the given group of words "No longer used because something new has been invented"(अब उपयोग नहीं किया जाता क्योंकि कुछ नया आविष्कार किया गया है)
 
 
• **Example**: The floppy disk has become obsolete due to modern USB flash drives.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Obsolete".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classic**: Judged over a period of time to be of the highest quality. (क्लासिक: समय की अवधि में न्याय किया गया कि इसकी तरह के उच्चतम गुणवत्ता।)
 
• **Ancient**: Belonging to the very distant past. (प्राचीन: बहुत दूर के अतीत में संबंधित।)
 
• **Ornamental**: Serving or intended as an ornament; decorative. (सजावटी: एक आभूषण के रूप में सेवा करने वाले या इरादा; सजावटी।)
